documentsSection.title: Documents
documentsSection.voucherPending: Generated automatically once the hotel confirms.
documentsSection.invoicePending: Available once accounting issues the invoice.
documentsSection.formatHint: Documents are issued as plain text files.

bookingDetail.cancelReasonRequired: Enter a cancellation reason (at least 2 characters)
bookingDetail.changeDatesRequired: Enter both dates and a reason (at least 2 characters)
bookingDetail.awaitingHotelConfirmation: Awaiting hotel confirmation — the room hasn't been released yet.
bookingDetail.roomsClickHint: Click a room to see its own dates, guests, meal plan and price below.
bookingDetail.correspondenceNotDelivered: Recorded but NOT emailed: mail is not configured. Copy the text and send it from your own mail client.
bookingDetail.approveInfo: Approve records your decision that this room is accepted and immediately sends the guest voucher to the agent. You will be asked to confirm first, and told if the hotel's confirmation number is still missing.
bookingDetail.rejectInfo: Reject is for when the room is not available. The room is released back to inventory and the agent is emailed that it could not be confirmed, with your reason. If that was the last room, you are then asked whether to close the whole application free of charge. You confirm before anything is sent.

bookingsList.dateModeStayingDescription: Bookings whose stay overlaps the selected date range (check-in ≤ range end, check-out > range start), excluding cancelled/rejected
bookingsList.dateModeCreatedDescription: Bookings created within the selected date range, regardless of check-in/check-out dates
bookingsList.dateModeCancellationsDescription: Bookings with check-in within the selected date range that were cancelled
bookingsList.summaryPageScoped: The totals below cover the current page only, not the whole result set.
bookingsList.flagsTruncated: Not all warnings are shown — too many upcoming arrivals.

claimGate.title: Nobody has taken this booking on
claimGate.detail: Every other action stays unavailable until someone takes it — so each action has an owner.

approveConfirm.title: Approve this room?
approveConfirm.body: This confirms {{room}} and immediately sends the guest voucher to the agent. It cannot be unsent.
approveConfirm.withNumber: The hotel's confirmation number {{number}} will appear on the voucher.
approveConfirm.withoutNumber: The hotel has not confirmed yet. The voucher will be sent without a confirmation number on it.

rejectConfirm.title: Reject this room?
rejectConfirm.body: {{room}} will be released back to inventory and the agent will be told it could not be confirmed.
rejectConfirm.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. the hotel has no availability for these dates
rejectConfirm.consequence: The agent is emailed immediately. This cannot be unsent, and a rejected room cannot be moved back to any other status.

freeCancel.title: Close this application free of charge?
freeCancel.body: Every room has been declined, so there is nothing left to deliver. Closing it now cancels the application with no cancellation fee for the agent.
freeCancel.pointFee: No cancellation fee is charged — the fee is recorded as 0, not left blank.
freeCancel.pointVisible: The application stays visible in the system as Cancelled. Nothing is deleted.
freeCancel.pointFinal: Cancelled is final — it cannot be moved to any other status afterwards.
freeCancel.reason: Cancelled free of charge — no room could be confirmed

sectionIssues.heading: Still outstanding here
sectionIssues.notTaken: Nobody has taken this booking into work
sectionIssues.roomsAwaitingDecision: Room {{rooms}} still awaiting approve or reject
sectionIssues.voucherWaiting: Voucher: waiting for the hotel's confirmation number

transferEdit.label: Transfer:
transferEdit.title: Change this room's transfer
transferEdit.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for the change
transferEdit.notice: The price is recalculated immediately. Nothing is cancelled. The admin panel is notified automatically — this lands in "Needs Attention" there until someone marks it reviewed.
